channel.title: Shadow of Israphel development blog
channel.description: Notes from an independent Minecraft fan recreation.

item.title: Episode 7 progress and new playtest screenshots
item.description: The private build now progresses through Episode 7. Three new gameplay captures, playtest findings, and a no-commentary video coming soon.

item.title: A bridge, a blank licence, and Fumblemore
item.description: Episode 4 now continues the Mistral tour into the upper city, across a companion-built bridge and into Fumblemore’s rather confused consultation.

item.title: Getting the city tour moving
item.description: Episode 3 follows Lysander around Mistral, with a visit to Granny, snowball tennis, and a few very awkward gravestones.

item.title: The first gameplay trailer
item.description: A first look at the private build, from the Yogcave to the airships above Mistral.

item.title: A little more time in Mistral
item.description: Optional errands, residents, and shops give the private build somewhere to linger after Episode 2.

item.title: A small doorway, a stuck companion
item.description: An Episode 1 playtest caught a blocked route. The fix lets the scene continue without skipping the walk.

item.title: Joining the first two episodes together
item.description: The opening through Episodes 1–2 can be played in one private build, with conversations and companion actions along the way.

item.title: Keeping track of the original story
item.description: An episode index, scene notes, and historical map references help keep the recreation grounded in the original series.
